```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
```
This script calculates pi in sliding windows and assigns it to the chromatin states.
```{r}
# Read chromatin states
chromatin_states <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/001_chromatin_states/chromatin_states_in_windows.csv")
# Pi in thaliana
pi_4fold_thaliana <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/002_div_thal_lyr/4fol_sites_thal_27g_tair10_based_pi.txt", header=T)
pi_4fold_thaliana$chromosome <- gsub("Chr", "", pi_4fold_thaliana$chromosome)
#Chromosome length
chromosome_lengths <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/chrom_length.csv", header=T)
```
# Calculate pi in windows 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
pi_4fold_thaliana$chrom_length <- chromosome_lengths$length[
  match(pi_4fold_thaliana$chromosome, chromosome_lengths$chrom)
]
# Define windows 
window_size <- 300000
step_size   <- 150000

calc_window_stats <- function(df, window_size, step_size) {
  results <- list()
  for (chr in unique(df$chromosome)) {
    chr_data   <- df[df$chromosome == chr, ]
    chr_length <- unique(chr_data$chrom_length)
    
    for (ws in seq(0, chr_length, by = step_size)) {
      we      <- min(ws + window_size, chr_length)
      overlap <- chr_data %>% filter(window_pos_1 >= ws & window_pos_1 < we)
      
      if (nrow(overlap) == 0) next
      
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        chromosome           = chr,
        window_start         = ws,
        window_end           = we,
        avg_pi_4_fold_window = sum(overlap$count_diffs, na.rm = TRUE) /
                               sum(overlap$count_comparisons, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    }
  }
  bind_rows(results)
}

window_results <- calc_window_stats(pi_4fold_thaliana, window_size, step_size)

```
# Attach histone states
```{r}
window_results$chromosome <- as.numeric(window_results$chromosome)
pi_4fold_thaliana_with_chromatin <- left_join(window_results, chromatin_states, by=c("chromosome"="chrom","window_start"="window_start", "window_end"="window_end"))
```
# Plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Filter to CH state only and join with pi
ch_data <- pi_4fold_thaliana_with_chromatin %>%
  dplyr::filter(merged_state == "CH") %>%
  dplyr::select(chromosome, window_start, window_end, avg_pi_4_fold_window, pct) %>%
  dplyr::rename(pct_CH = pct)


library(ggpubr)

ggplot(ch_data, aes(x = pct_CH, y = avg_pi_4_fold_window)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.6, fill = "#4477AA", color = "black", 
             shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  stat_cor(aes(label = ..r.label..), method = "pearson", 
         label.x.npc = "center", label.y.npc = "top", size = 3.5)+
  labs(
    x = "% Constitutive Heterochromatin (CH)",
    y = expression(pi ~ "(4-fold sites)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, nrow = 1)

ggplot(ch_data, aes(x = pct_CH)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "#4477AA",color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 15, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(
    x = "% Constitutive Heterochromatin (CH)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, nrow = 1)



# Compute per-chromosome medians
median_data <- ch_data %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  summarise(median_pct = median(pct_CH, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(ch_data, aes(x = pct_CH)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "#4477AA", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 15, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(data = median_data, aes(xintercept = median_pct),
             linetype = "solid", color = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "% Constitutive Heterochromatin (CH)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, nrow = 1)
```
# Plot without centromere gap
```{r}
scale_factor <- max(ch_data$avg_pi_4_fold_window, na.rm = TRUE) / 
                max(ch_data$pct_CH, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(ch_data, aes(x = window_start)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = ch_data %>% filter(pct_CH > 20),
    aes(xmin = window_start, xmax = window_end,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = "darkred", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
 geom_line(aes(y = avg_pi_4_fold_window), color = "#4477AA", linewidth = 1.2) +
geom_line(aes(y = pct_CH * scale_factor), color = "darkred", alpha = 1, linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Avg Pi (4-fold)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "% Constitutive Heterochromatin (CH)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free", nrow = 5) +
  labs(x = "Window start (bp)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = "#4477AA"),
    axis.text.y.left   = element_text(color = "#4477AA"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "darkred"),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "darkred"),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey90")
  )
```

# Plot with centromere gap
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
# Add centromere boundaries 
centromere <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz2023.txt", header = T) %>%
#  dplyr::rename(chromosome = chrom)

ch_data <- pi_4fold_thaliana_with_chromatin %>%
  dplyr::filter(merged_state == "CH") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(chromosome = as.character(chromosome)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(centromere %>% mutate(chromosome = as.character(chromosome)), by = "chromosome") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    avg_pi_4_fold_window = ifelse(window_start >= start & window_start <= stop, NA, avg_pi_4_fold_window),
    pct                  = ifelse(window_start >= start & window_start <= stop, NA, pct)
  )

scale_factor <- max(ch_data$avg_pi_4_fold_window, na.rm = TRUE) / 
                max(ch_data$pct, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(ch_data, aes(x = window_start)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_pi_4_fold_window), color = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(aes(y = pct * scale_factor), color = "darkred", alpha = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Avg Pi (4-fold)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "% Constitutive Heterochromatin (CH)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free", nrow = 5) +
  labs(x = "Window start (bp)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
    axis.text.y.left   = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "darkred"),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "darkred"),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey90")
  )
```
